bio: Leward J. LaFleur II is a U.S. Navy veteran who has served as Marion County Judge since 2018, presiding over Commissioners Court and carrying countywide administrative, budget, emergency-management, criminal-court, and probate responsibilities. Public records document regional workforce, transportation and water-policy leadership. Reported misconduct allegations remain disputed and procedurally unresolved; RepWatchr has not located a later public disposition as of July 27, 2026. His performance grade remains Not Rated while role-specific records are collected.
